mapper.select: select t.para_code id,t.para_name text ,t.IS_FORBID,t.FORBID_ENUM from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA t

select PTL_BAG_ID id,PTL_BAG_NAME name,'' as pId from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE
PTL_BAG_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bagName}),'%')
and PTL_BAG_ID not in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR where PORTFOLIO_LEVEL =#{portfLevel} and IND_ID =#{indId} )
mapper.insert: insert into RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR ( IND_ID, IND_NAME, IND_TYPE, SUP_TYPE, EXPR, TIME_POINT, SUP_FREQUENCY, WARN_COND, FOUL_COND, IS_ADJUST, ADJUST, IS_ENABLED, MEMO, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, SUP_DIRECTION, APPROVE_COND, IS_EXCP_WHEN_DIV_ZERO, COMPARE_DAYS, IS_DISPLAY_ORIGINAL, IND_NUM, SUP_DOC ) values ( #{indId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{indName , jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{indType, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{supType, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{expr, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{timePoint, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{supFrequency, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{warnCond, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{foulCond, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{isAdjust,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjust,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{isEnabled, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{createUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{supDirection, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{approveCond, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isExcpWhenDivZero,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{compareDays,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{isDisplayOriginal,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{indNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{supDoc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

insert into RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR ( PORTFOLIO_ID, IND_ID, PORTFOLIO_LEVEL, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) values ( #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{indId , jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{portfolioLevel, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR }, #{createUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select:
select m.IND_ID indId, m.IND_NAME indName, m.IND_TYPE indType, m.EXPR expr, m.SUP_TYPE supType, m.TIME_POINT timePoint, m.SUP_FREQUENCY supFrequency , m.WARN_COND warnCond , m.FOUL_COND foulCond , m.IS_ENABLED isEnabled , m.SUP_DIRECTION supDirection, m.APPROVE_COND approveCond, m.MEMO memo, n.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioCodeConst, m.IS_ADJUST isAdjust, m.ADJUST adjust, m.IS_ENABLED isEnabled, m.IS_EXCP_WHEN_DIV_ZERO isExcpWhenDivZero, m.COMPARE_DAYS compareDays, m.IS_DISPLAY_ORIGINAL isDisplayOriginal, m.IND_NUM indNum, m.SUP_DOC supDoc from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR m left join (select XMLAGG(xmlelement(E,PORTFOLIO_ID || ',')).extract('//text()').getclobval() as PORTFOLIO_ID ,IND_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR GROUP BY IND_ID) n on m.IND_ID=n.IND_ID
m.IND_ID =#{indId}

select m.IND_ID indId, m.IND_NAME indName, m.IND_TYPE indType, m.EXPR expr, m.SUP_TYPE supType, m.TIME_POINT timePoint, m.SUP_FREQUENCY supFrequency , m.WARN_COND warnCond , m.FOUL_COND foulCond , m.IS_ENABLED isEnabled , m.SUP_DIRECTION supDirection, m.APPROVE_COND approveCond, m.MEMO memo, n.RULE_ID as portfolioCodeConst, m.IS_ADJUST isAdjust, m.ADJUST adjust, m.IS_ENABLED isEnabled, m.IS_EXCP_WHEN_DIV_ZERO isExcpWhenDivZero, m.COMPARE_DAYS compareDays, m.IS_DISPLAY_ORIGINAL isDisplayOriginal from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR m left join (select XMLAGG(xmlelement(E,RULE_ID || ',')).extract('//text()').getclobval() as RULE_ID ,IND_ID from RSK_RULE_INDICATOR GROUP BY IND_ID) n on m.IND_ID=n.IND_ID
m.IND_ID =#{indId}

select m.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, m.IND_ID indId, m.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL portfolioLevel, m.START_DATE startDate, m.END_DATE endDate from RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR m
m.IND_ID =#{indId}

select PARA_ASSET_TYPE paraAssetType, PARA_ASSET_SEC_TYPE paraAssetSecType from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA
PARA_CODE = #{indParamId}

SELECT DISTINCT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR
IND_ID = #{indId}
